name: Benchmark v2 set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: Number of top reward tasks to run (1-10)
        required: true
        default: 2
        type: number
      agent:
        description: Agent type
        required: true
        default: default
        type: string
      provider:
        description: Provider
        required: true
        default: openai
        type: string
      model:
        description: Model name
        required: true
        default: gpt-4o-mini
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: Timeout in minutes
        required: true
        default: 30
        type: number

jobs:
  select_tasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      task_ids: ${{ steps.select.outputs.task_ids }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Select tasks
        id: select
        env:
          TASK_COUNT: ${{ inputs.task_count }}
        run: |
          TASK_IDS=$(jq -c ".[0:$TASK_COUNT]" data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json)
          echo "task_ids=$TASK_IDS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

  benchmark:
    needs: select_tasks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.timeout }}
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        task_id: ${{ fromJSON(needs.select_tasks.outputs.task_ids) }}
      max-parallel: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        shell: bash
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun run benchmark-v2 --task-id ${{ matrix.task_id }} --agent ${{ inputs.agent }} --provider ${{ inputs.provider }} --model ${{ inputs.model }} --timeout ${{ inputs.timeout }}
        shell: bash
